pairs.help: Pairs the system watches and may trade.

statArb.enabled.help: Statistical arbitrage on the BTC/ETH price ratio.

statArb.lookbackCandles.help: 15m candles used for the ratio's mean and spread (96 = 1 day).

statArb.zEntry.help: Ratio z-score that creates a candidate.

statArb.zExit.help: Ratio z-score at which the gap counts as closed.

momentum.minVolumeRatio.help: Volume must be at least this multiple of its 30-day average.

momentum.targetR.help: Target distance as a multiple of the stop distance.

meanReversion.maxBandWidthPct.help: Bollinger band width (as % of price) below which volatility counts as low.

meanReversion.rsiEntry.help: RSI at or below this suggests a stretched move down.
